steps.title: A guided first run
steps.body:
You are Teresā Albukerkē, the defeated candidate. Reach the jet and leave within 72 hours.

This tutorial guides you to the border. The airfield is yours to play.
steps.goal: Know the goal and the deadline

steps.title: The map
steps.body:
The gold dot marks you. The red eye marks where the inquiry is looking. Exposure rises when they match.

At exposure 10 you are held. Each hold is worse than the last. The third is house arrest.
steps.goal: Read exposure and the inquiry on the map

steps.title: Each round has five phases
steps.body: **News**, **Phone**, **Move**, **Roll**, **Sosā**. On the phone you answer messages and place one call. Then you make one move.
steps.goal: Know the five phases

steps.title: Answer your brother
steps.body:
Duartē found a jet. He needs a destination to book the crew.

Choose **Confirm Lāyūna**. The tutorial has already picked where you are going.
steps.goal: Answer a message

steps.title: Start an arrangement
steps.body: **Call Duartē about aircraft**. The call takes an hour; his reply is due six hours later.
steps.goal: Start an arrangement by phone

steps.title: A promise is not an arrangement
steps.body: The route shows when the reply is due. An ally must pass a reliability roll to deliver. If the call fails, try again.
steps.goal: Tell a promise from a delivered arrangement

steps.title: Leave the house
steps.body: Select **Decoy convoy**. Read the time and roll required, then press **Commit**. Nando's card makes this approach available.
steps.goal: Read an approach before committing

steps.title: The die
steps.body:
Cards lower the roll you need. They stay in your hand unless used or withdrawn.

You reached Santa Laura. The inquiry still watches the house.
steps.goal: See how cards change the roll

steps.title: The inquiry acts
steps.body:
Sosā sent the travel ban to every post. Border rolls are now one point harder unless you hold a delay card.

The inquiry acts every three hours.
steps.goal: See the inquiry act on a schedule

steps.title: Engage the sponsor
steps.body:
**Call Salek about your visa**. He is Atlanta's sponsor and can ask Lāyūna to let you in.

Read his terms before committing. Calling accepts them.
steps.goal: Accept terms by calling

steps.title: Pay someone who takes money
steps.body: Nando's cousin accepts money. Choose **Hire a driver and plain car**.
steps.goal: Use an ally who takes money

steps.title: Work finished while you drove
steps.body:
Duartē confirmed the crew while you drove.

The inquiry told the papers you had left. They are now looking in Portô Venla.
steps.goal: See arrangements progress while you travel

steps.title: Nonā Rosa's problem
steps.body:
Nonā Rosa's cooperative truck was impounded.

Choose **Help Nonā Rosa free the truck**. It takes three hours and earns her help.
steps.goal: Earn help by helping

steps.title: Relationships give cards
steps.body:
Nonā Rosa offers her truck and a driver. Their card can help you later.

Trusted allies are less likely to inform when Sosā questions them.
steps.goal: Know that trust lowers the risk of betrayal

steps.title: Who meets you across the line
steps.body: **Call Duartē about reception**. He can reach Vélez in Esmeralda. Her officials could meet you at the border.
steps.goal: Arrange reception across the line

steps.title: Onto the freight
steps.body:
Choose **Pay Holt for a crate**. Your truck card improves the roll.

The yardmaster will take your money and report you.
steps.goal: Get a card for one place

steps.title: Board at midnight
steps.body: Holt's crate is in your hand. It works in one place: this yard, tonight. **Board the midnight freight**. The card makes the roll certain, and it is spent when the train leaves.
steps.goal: Spend a card where it counts

steps.title: The border
steps.body:
Three posts cross the line. One has taken Valdória’s money, and you do not know which. Vélez’s people, when they come, cover one of the others.

You can cross now or wait for reception to be arranged.
steps.goal: Know where the second passport counts

steps.title: Cross at the rail post
steps.body: Select **Cross at the Paso Huhūi rail post**. Your second passport goes on the desk. Read how the ban and your cards change the roll, then commit.
steps.goal: Read how the ban changes a roll

steps.title: Susana. The rest is yours.
steps.body:
You crossed. Esmeralda lets you fly from Susana and nothing more. Now fuel the jet and get the visa. Your party card has no influence here.

Call Duartē and Salek as needed. Depart when the aircraft and permission are ready, or risk leaving without permission.

Press **Finish** to continue. Rolls and inquiry moves are no longer scripted.
steps.goal: Play the airfield alone

steps.title: A guided run as Sofīā
steps.goal: Know the goal and what you cannot see
steps.body:
You are Sofīā Leōnī, aide to the incoming government. Stop Teresā Albukerkē before her jet leaves on Tuesday afternoon.

You never see where she is. You see reports, and reports arrive late.

steps.title: What the scene shows
steps.goal: Tell your search from her position
steps.body:
The scene shows where your search is looking. The box at the top says how old your last report is.

She could be anywhere else on the route.

steps.title: Each round has five phases
steps.goal: Know the five phases
steps.body: **Reports**, **Desk**, **Order**, **Roll**, **Her move**. At the desk you answer the minister and send one request. Then you give one order.

steps.title: The minister wants a location
steps.goal: Answer a message without guessing
steps.body:
You have nothing to tell him yet. If you name the wrong town, your own offices chase it.

Choose **Ask for six hours**.

steps.title: Ask Esmeralda early
steps.goal: Start a slow request before you need it
steps.body:
Your ministry has no power across the border. Esmeralda can hold her, but the embassy takes ten hours to answer.

Choose **Ask Esmeralda to hold her**, then **Send**.

steps.title: Put the ban on paper
steps.goal: Read an order before sending it
steps.body: Select **Circulate the travel ban**. Read the roll it needs and the hours it takes, then press **Send the order**.

steps.title: Reports prove less than they say
steps.goal: Judge a report by what it proves
steps.body:
While your order ran, she moved. Press **See what came in** to read what reached your desk.

Each report says what it proves and what it does not. A car leaving is not proof she was in it.

steps.title: News on your side
steps.goal: Weigh a choice by its tags
steps.body:
Every few hours something happens at the ministry. Each choice shows its cost as tags. A real lead is a true report; a false lead points the wrong way.

When the news card opens, choose **Check the one that gave plates**.

steps.title: A sent ban is not a closed border
steps.goal: Confirm a request reached the people who act on it
steps.body:
The ban went out, but the border post has not read it.

Choose **Confirm the ban at the post**, then **Send**.

steps.title: Act on the lead
steps.goal: Move the search to the newest report
steps.body: The plates gave you a real lead. Follow it if it points somewhere new. Search if it points where you are already looking.

steps.title: How she gets caught
steps.goal: Know how searches turn into holds
steps.body:
When your search sits on her stop, her exposure rises. At 10 she is held. The third hold is house arrest, and that is your win.

She will move when she knows you are close.

steps.title: The rest is yours
steps.goal: Play on without the guide
steps.body:
Rolls and news are no longer scripted. The debrief at the end shows where she really was.

Press **Finish** to continue.
